notes: Qualification notes: Arcadia is a regulated EU capital markets firm (trading + compliance). Primary ask: private VPC deployment with strict data residency (EU-only), integration with customer-managed KMS (BYOK), and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. Latency targets: p50 < 80ms for short chat (64 token), p95 < 250ms for production reranking flows; throughput: 1200 qps for embeddings pipelines during EOD runs (batch preferred). Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for isolation and compliance.
vpc_architecture: Suggested topology: dedicated inference subnets (private) per AZ; control plane endpoints placed in customer-managed private subnets; management plane access via customer-approved bastion or private VPN; no public IPs on inferencing nodes
Outbound: NAT Gateway or managed egress proxy required for image/model pulls and package updates; customer prefers using VPC endpoints (S3, ECR, KMS, STS) so that egress to internet is minimized
Inbound: only allow TLS (443) from Redwood management plane IP ranges via VPC peering or Transit Gateway. Alternatively use private control plane deployed in-customer VPC per Redwood Private model
KMS integration: BYOK with AWS KMS/CloudHSM - Redwood needs key ARN and access principals; recommend separate CMK for inference data at rest and a different CMK for logs
Audit logging: push service logs to customer CloudWatch/Elastic/Splunk via VPC endpoints; retention requested 3+ years for compliance — discuss long-term archival options
Regions: primary eu-west-1, DR eu-central-1 requested; discuss latency implications for EU traders in nordics/cee; plan for cross-region replication policy for cert/key backups
security_review_summary: InfoSec list: 1) Data residency - all persisted data must stay in EU; 2) KMS - BYOK + HSM-backed keys + key rotation policy; 3) Network - deny-all default with explicit allow for Redwood management control plane; 4) Logging - immutable audit logs sent to customer SIEM; 5) Pen test & architecture diagram required for legal approval
poc_plan: 2-week sandbox POC: deploy Redwood Private control plane in customer VPC (eu-west-1), 2x A100 inference nodes, run 3 workload scenarios (chat latency, rerank p95, nightly embeddings batch). Deliverables: latency/cost dashboard, KMS integration test, audit log pipeline to Splunk, architecture runbook.
commercial_notes: Initial ARR estimate 250k-750k depending on committed Dedicated capacity. Enterprise procurement cycle — legal + security + procurement. Customer prefers annual commitment with 30% discount for 12 month reserved capacity.
sales_playbook_tips: Bring infra/security engineer to next workshop, prepare BYOK integration doc and recommended KMS policies, provide sample network diagram that enforces zero public egress from nodes, include SLA wording for data residency and key ownership.
short_summary: High-potential EU enterprise. Evaluation stage focused on architecture fit for Private VPC. Critical path: architecture workshop, BYOK KMS details, legal/pen-test sign-off. Next: schedule 90-min infra workshop and exchange CIDR/key ARNs.
